notes.title: Congratulations to "Fantasy Amusement Park" breaking through 10,000 sets!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44301000/1e56cab338a5469821ffa3bb1a209b416a041a85.png[/img]

Thank you all so much for your support!
Sales have now surpassed 10,000 units!
A new one is currently in the works, and we'll be adding more fun gameplay! 
More exciting H-sessions!
